files.description: Primary EHI export documentation (b)(10). 19-page PDF describing single-patient and bulk-patient C-CDA export with data dictionary listing all C-CDA sections, XPATHs, and code systems. Includes annotated screenshots of the EHI-Export-Request UI. Created November 2023, references MDCare V5.1.

FHIR R4 SMART on FHIR API documentation for (g)(10) certified API. 20-page PDF covering OAuth 2.0 authentication, FHIR resource request examples (Patient, AllergyIntolerance, CarePlan, etc.), and Terms of Use. This documents the g(10) API, not the b(10) export, but is included for completeness as it was linked alongside the EHI export on the vendor homepage.
FHIR R4 Bundle (type: collection) containing Endpoint and Organization resources for the FHIR server at fhir.mdcare.com. This is the g(10) service base URL JSON, not related to the b(10) export.
